author: IGN
description:
Check out the play style of the newest character in Season Pass 5, Jam Kuradoberi, in this trailer for Guilty Gear Strive, an action fighting game developed by Arc System Works. Players can soon gain access to a new playable character with the Season Pass 5 as Jam Kuradoberi takes to the fight. Jam Kuradoberi is scheduled to be released on April, 9, 2026 with the Season Pass 5 of Guilty Gear Strive on PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam).

author: IGN
description:
Watch the season 5 and 2.0 update for Guilty Gear Strive, the latest entry in the 2.5D fighting game franchise developed by ARC System Works. As part of the update, players have now have access to a newly participating character "Jam Kuradoberi," plus new special moves for select characters, and the introduction of a new "Counter Blitz" mechanic. Players can also look forward to the "Blazing Pass" system, allowing them to earn in-game rewards based on their in-game progression. Guilty Gear Strive is available now for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam).

author: IGN
description:
Screamer reviewed by Luke Reilly on Xbox Series X. Also available on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series S, and PC.

"A blazing, tumbling, and anime-infused collision of weapons-based racing and drift-happy driving, Screamer is potentially what you’d get if you locked Blur in a room for 12 months with nothing but a Crunchyroll subscription. Fabulous to look at and confidently assembled, it’s a challenging arcade racer with a clear identity to call its own. It’s true that Screamer’s high-speed thrills might be mostly neutered on its twistiest tracks, several of the cars feel more sloppy to drive than others, the central tournament mode makes some noticeable missteps with its difficulty curve, and its cast of emotional anime dandies do quickly get pretty tedious. title: Screamer Review
